title: Controlling Incompatible Magic: Ontology-Conditioned Activation Steering in a Fantasy Landscape
description: Research protocol preprint (v0.1.0). A prospective experiment on contrastive activation steering for a versioned causal fantasy ontology. Includes a symbolic benchmark, executable evaluator, steering implementation, adversarial related-work audit, and analysis plan. No model-performance results are reported. The novelty claim is limited to the candidate version-transition evaluation protocol, not activation steering itself. Code uses MIT; manuscript, documentation, and benchmark data use CC BY 4.0.
notes: Prospective protocol; experimental results pending. Author name is based on the authenticated GitHub profile and should be confirmed before deposition. Affiliation and ORCID have not been supplied.
